title: Missing Cargo
summary: Debug a missing-data report: a misspelt package, != NA, a missing na.rm and over-eager na.omit().
hints: The first error names a package that doesn't exist. Check the spelling of dplyr.
`x != NA` is always NA, so `filter()` keeps nothing. Ask the question with `!is.na(sleep_hours)`. And `mean()` needs `na.rm = TRUE`.
`na.omit(morale)` drops anyone missing *anything*, sleep included. Look only at the items: `morale |> filter(if_all(m1:m6, ~ !is.na(.x))) |> nrow()`.
